input: Look into long-term care insurance for my parents

gold.taskTitle: Research Long-Term Care Insurance for Parents
gold.taskDescription: Investigate long-term care insurance options that may be suitable for the user's parents.

questions.title: How old are each of your parents right now?
questions.description: Understand the current ages of both parents to assess eligibility and pricing windows.

questions.title: Do your parents have any existing health conditions?
questions.description: Identify pre-existing conditions that could affect insurability or policy terms.

questions.title: Are you researching this for one or both parents?
questions.description: Determine whether the search covers one parent or a joint/couples policy for both.

questions.title: What is the approximate monthly budget for premiums?
questions.description: Establish a financial boundary to filter realistic policy options.

questions.title: Have your parents expressed a preference for in-home care versus a facility?
questions.description: Understand the type of care setting they anticipate needing, which shapes policy requirements.

questions.title: Who is taking the lead on this decision, you or your parents?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is researching independently or collaboratively with their parents.

questions.title: Is there a specific timeline by which a decision should be made?
questions.description: Determine urgency so the plan can be scoped and prioritized appropriately.
